landing.lead: GnomeVPN brings up a tunnel to a node in another country in one tap. The connection is indistinguishable from ordinary HTTPS. No logs, no ads, no traffic caps.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Card payment via YooKassa. From {price} ₽ per month, cancel in one click, no hidden charges.
how.step2Body: Every node is a separate server. Switch on the fly, no manual reconnect.
how.step3Body: Through our app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android in one tap. Or download a config and open it in any Hysteria2 client.

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: No. The server only knows that you have an active subscription and which node you picked. Browsing history is never collected or stored.
faq.a2: Access stays until the end of the paid period — you get exactly what you paid for. No further charges will be made.
faq.a3: Our app covers Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. On iOS it works through a config from your account — open it in any Hysteria2 client such as Hiddify, Streisand or NekoBox.
faq.a4: We do not pay for influencer ads and we do not rent an office. The price covers servers and payment processing.

features.title: What is inside
features.splitBody: Pick the applications that go through the VPN. Everything else takes the direct route — no speed lost, no traffic wasted on the node.
features.devicesBody: Desktop and phone at once on a single subscription. Connect on one and the other sees it immediately.
features.autostartBody: The app launches with the system and raises the tunnel on its own. Nothing to press.
features.lanBody: Printers, NAS and the router stay reachable while the tunnel is up — local subnets are routed around the VPN.
features.noLogsBody: The server knows your subscription is active and which node you picked. Browsing history is never collected.
features.updatesBody: The app updates itself and verifies the signature on the client, so a build cannot be swapped in transit.

platforms.title: Where it runs
platforms.windowsBody: A full client with split tunneling and autostart. Never asks for administrator rights.
platforms.macosBody: A native app running the same tunnel. It asks for permission once, when the service is installed.
platforms.linuxBody: deb, rpm and AppImage. The service installs through systemd and sing-box runs the tunnel.
platforms.androidBody: Available on Google Play. The tunnel survives being swiped away and keeps running in the background.
platforms.iosBody: Grab the config from your account and open it in Streisand, Hiddify or any Hysteria2 client.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: GnomeVPN is a VPN service built on the Hysteria2 protocol. It is designed to know as little about you as possible: browsing history is never collected and is physically stored nowhere.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Only what the service cannot run without: an email address and a hashed password for signing in; subscription details such as the plan and its expiry; a device identifier the app generates itself, unrelated to any advertising ID; and the country you picked.

noLogs.title: Connection logs
noLogs.body: We keep no logs of your traffic. Visited addresses, DNS queries, connection contents and browsing history are never recorded. Nodes count transferred bytes only, which is how an active session is told apart from an abandoned one so device slots can be freed.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Payments are handled by YooKassa. Card details are processed by the payment provider — we never receive or store them. Our side keeps only the fact of payment, its amount, the subscription period and, if auto-renewal is on, the payment method identifier issued by YooKassa.

storage.title: Where data is stored
storage.body: Account data is stored on servers in Russia. Passwords are kept as irreversible hashes. Device and config records are removed together with the subscription or on your account deletion request.

thirdParty.title: Sharing with third parties
thirdParty.body: We do not sell or share your data. The exceptions are the payment provider needed to process a payment, and cases where disclosure is explicitly required by law.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request a copy of your data, correct it, or delete your account entirely. Email us at the address below — requests are handled within 30 days.

children.title: Children
children.body: The service is not intended for anyone under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, the date at the top of the page is updated. Material changes are additionally announced to the email on your account.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For questions about personal data and this policy, write to the address below.
